scores.notes: Aged Adam lies dying on a mat among a large mourning family outside tents and mud-brick houses; hands and faces check out on zoom, no writing anywhere, paint runs to every edge.
Fire and brimstone streak from dark cloud onto a walled city with smoke rising, tiny travellers on the road; no lettering and the washes reach the edges, so no unpainted edge recorded.

Holmes at the window holding the slip has the face, curly dark hair and long collared coat of Benedict Cumberbatch (BBC Sherlock), a screen likeness. Letters and slip on the table and notes pinned to the wall carry unreadable pseudo-script lines.
Night storm: Jesus asleep on a cushion in the stern while disciples shake him awake and others bail; hands fine on zoom, no lettering.

Two large robed men (one with a staff) stand in the foreground with more bystanders, none called for by the verse. Only the centre seraph has six wings covering face and feet; the left and right seraphs have about three wings, one bare-faced holding tongs, so the creatures do not follow the text. Throne holds only draped cloth and smoke, no figure.
Father gestures while one servant drapes a red robe on the ragged son, one kneels fastening a sandal and one offers a ring on a dish; hands fine, no lettering.
Vaulted stone treasury piled with coin chests, gold bars, jars and carpets, with no figure at all, so Wisdom is not drawn; the band on the left jar is rosette ornament, not writing.

Hare and Hatter lean on the sleeping Dormouse at one corner of the long tea table under the tree while Alice sits in a large armchair at the end; the top-right corner fades to bare white paper (accepted). No lettering on hats or china.

Moses with staff points the assembled Israelites, with loaded donkeys and tents, away from the cloud-capped mountain; God appears only as cloud. Corners and edges fade to white paper (accepted); no lettering.
Job stands on an ash heap strewn with potsherds looking up at a towering whirlwind outside city walls; no figure in the whirlwind or light, no lettering.

Platform scene with the train steaming off and a huge feather-like smoke column over trees matches the text, but the gaunt hatless Holmes (slicked-back hair, hollow cheeks) reads as Peter Cushing. The station-master's paper shows unreadable print lines and a small wall plaque has illegible marks.
Burning streaks rain from smoke cloud onto two walled cities on the plain while a few small figures flee up a path; no lettering, painted to the edges.

King in purple kneels pressing his ring into a wax patch on the pit rim while two workers drag a stone with ropes and turbaned lords look on; one worker standing inside the pit and the stone being small for the mouth are quibbles, not contradictions. Bottom-right marks are rock cracks, not a signature.

A large man in a rough cloak with a staff stands back-to-viewer in the left foreground (the narrator John), not called for by the verse. The four winged creatures with eyes, glass sea and rainbow throne are shown; the throne holds only green and pink mist and drapery, no face or limbs.

Alice leans in questioning the drowsy Dormouse with its cup while the March Hare lifts a teapot and the Hatter holds cup and bread-and-butter under the tree; hat tags are blank, hands fine, no actor likeness.

The plaster wall carries three rows of glowing pseudo-glyph writing (no real words) with two disembodied glowing hands; the left hand shows six digits. Daniel gesturing to the wall before the enthroned king fits the moment; modern fork and knife on the foreground table are an anachronism.

Alice drinks from the bottle beside the glass table and the little curtained door, as the text says; a paper tag on the table and one hanging from it carry small squiggle pseudo-script. Pale washes reach the edges, so no unpainted edge recorded.

Rope logic contradicts itself: Daniel stands on the pit floor loosely holding a rope while helpers inside the pit pull against the men outside, so he is not actually being taken up. Corners and edges fade to white paper (accepted). King in purple leaning over the pit is right; no lettering.

Vault with Watson crouched behind a crate with his revolver, Holmes by the still-lit dark lantern and two men waiting at the right matches the text; a label on a stacked crate at right carries two lines of squiggle script. Top-left corner is bare white paper (accepted). Holmes's profile is a generic gaunt type, not a clear actor.
Storm-tossed boat shipping water with disciples bailing, Jesus asleep in the stern and other small boats nearby; no lettering.

Egyptian chariots and horsemen drive between two walls of water on the seabed; no figure for God. Tiny fret-like strokes on a chariot panel are ornament, and the white at top right is wave foam rather than bare paper.

The Egyptian chariots charge toward the viewer while the Israelite crowd and Moses with his staff stand behind them heading the same way, so pursuer and pursued are reversed and the chase contradicts itself. No lettering, no figure for God.

Moses sits on a stone with Aaron (in ephod and breastplate) and Hur each holding up a hand against a sunset sky, battle in the valley below; garment hems are ornament only, hands fine, paint to the edges.
A well-dressed older man sets a stone into the wall alongside labourers with Jerusalem behind, fitting Rephaiah making repairs; no lettering.
Pillar of cloud rests on the tabernacle in the middle of the tented camp with people and animals staying put; no lettering.
David has loosed the sling and Goliath pitches forward with a dark mark at the forehead, armies watching; the wound is not gory, weapons and hands are coherent, no lettering.
Daniel stands unharmed among calm lions speaking up to the king at the den opening, with a glowing winged angel beside him; the bright top is the opening, not bare paper, and there is no lettering.

Glass-like reflective floor with lion, calf, man-faced and eagle creatures, winged and covered in eyes, around fire and cloud; no figure for God and no lettering. Oddities noted but not scored as faults: the lion wears a sleeved robe and the throne is drawn as a gold ark-like chest. Top brightness is painted radiance, not bare paper.
Father runs with arms out toward the ragged son on the road with the house far behind, just before the embrace; hands fine, no lettering.
Peter grips the lame man's hand and lifts him at the temple gate with John beside and onlookers behind; minor quibble that it looks like the man's left hand, no lettering.

The party walks away from the burning house toward the viewer instead of hastening to it, and the engineer with the bandaged hand is drawn as a boy. Holmes's profile reads as Peter Cushing and he carries a bent screen-style pipe and magnifier; the station-master's paper shows unreadable print lines. House ablaze with three fire-engines is present.

Holmes at centre with the lantern has the widow's peak, hollow cheeks and frontal features of Peter Cushing, a screen likeness. Vault, crates, Watson crouched with revolver on a crate and the two other men fit the text; bottom-left corner is bare white paper (accepted). Crate shows only a hasp, no lettering.
Father embraces the ragged barefoot son on the road with the house in the distance; edges vignette into white paper all round (accepted). Hands check out, no lettering.

Alice with flamingo, the Cheshire Cat's grinning head and the Queen close behind her are right, but the three courtiers at right are ordinary humans in Tudor dress rather than flat oblong cards. Marks are only heart pips on the two card soldiers and on clothing (no indices or words). Corners fade to white paper (accepted).
A richly dressed ruler guides a large block onto the wall with workers, hoist ropes, scaffold and the temple city behind; corners and left edge are bare white paper (accepted). No lettering.
Moses strikes the rock with his rod and water pours out while Aaron in priestly dress, the people, sheep, cattle, donkey and goats gather to drink; no lettering.
Saul in royal robe has just hurled the spear, whose point strikes the wall beside David as he dodges with his harp, household members recoiling; no spirit figure is drawn and there is no lettering.
Israelites led by Moses with his staff walk on dry seabed between two towering walls of water under a night sky; no figure for God, no lettering.

Hatter with teacup and bitten bread, the Hare arm-in-arm with the Dormouse, King and spectacled Queen on the bench and the animal jury with slates are right, but a second crowned white-bearded king with a card body stands large in the right foreground duplicating the King. Marks: an unreadable scribble on the hat tag and suit pips on two card figures; top brightness is a window, not bare paper.

A loose sheet in the satchel at lower right carries letter-form writing whose first line reads roughly 'The cone of ooth' with real words, and the open scroll is filled with pseudo-script lines. The image is carried by an unnamed author-scribe (a narrator figure) with an elderly couple behind, none named in the verse. Washes reach the edges.
Dark sea under black cloud with a luminous mist breaking over the water, light appearing over the deep; the glow is amorphous with no human shape, no lettering.
